_comment: HATS-1856 — the one source of check/test runner names for the PreToolUse Bash guards. Grouped rather than flat because the guards ask different questions of the same names: tool_call_hygiene_guard.sh asks 'did a runner run, and was its exit code masked' (every group but python_interpreters — a bare `python foo.py` returns a status nobody claimed was a check), while wt_interpreter_gate.py asks 'which checkout will this import from' (only the groups that resolve the project's Python package — ruff and the foreign runners import nothing of it). A name added here reaches both; which of them acts on it stays each guard's own policy. Entries are matched as whole words, with a space meaning one-or-more whitespace.
